title: Missed the regression lecture: catch up before the worksheet
request: I missed the regression lecture. What do I need to know about residuals, and can you plan my catch-up before the worksheet is due?

facts.statement: A residual equals observed Y minus predicted Y_hat.
Ordinary least squares fits beta_0 and beta_1 by minimizing the sum of squared residuals.
Inspecting a residual plot helps identify nonlinear patterns or changing error variance, and large residuals suggest poor fit for a particular observation.
A basic linear regression analysis assumes a linear mean relationship and makes assumptions about residual behavior.
